correctness.rationale: For y≠0, interior P_y(x)=y/[x(y-x)] has collision pairs x and y-x except when x/y is in B={r:r(1-r)=1}, |B|<=2; boundary fiber x=0,y has y^-1. Every pointed automorphism sends good paired fibers to good paired fibers, yielding F(y-x)=F(y)-F(x) outside B. In fields q>=7, at most six excluded auxiliary choices give negation/additivity, while q5 has B empty; q2,3,4 are directly small additive-inversion cases. From F◦ι=ι◦F get c=F(1), c²=1. G=cF is additive, fixes one, preserves inversion, and Hua identity x²y=x-(x^-1+(y^-1-x)^-1)^-1 gives multiplicativity, hence Frobenius. Each ±Frobenius conversely preserves star. For socle nonzero u, the rational condition on α=t/u yields α²+α+1=0 (or 4=1) for all admissible α, impossible for q>=5. Independent complete pointed-permutation checks q2,3,5,7 recovered 1,2,2,2 automorphisms. Universal proof does not rely on those finite checks.
